source.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one original production book-cover background for the existing Arbor biblical story 'Joseph and His Brothers'. Portrait composition intended for a 3:4 cover. NO text, lettering, symbols, logos, borders, panels, or watermark anywhere.
INPUT REFERENCES: image 1 PL1.webp supplies the established luminous painted picture-book style, natural ancient landscape, fine brushwork, tactile cloth/stone and the identity of Bun, the small blue knitted toy rabbit. Image 2 PL4.webp supplies the same painterly adult facial treatment and period fabric/material quality. They are STYLE references only: do not copy King Saul, crowns, armor, swords, shields, tree markings, sheep, or that scene.
STORY WORLD: an inviting ancient Egyptian granary courtyard at the edge of the Nile, pale sun-warmed mudbrick and plaster walls, simple timber doors, grain baskets and tied wheat sacks, date palms, distant green river fields and ochre hills. Warm morning light, dignified and lived-in, not a fantasy palace. Refined natural colour, no yellow filter, no photographic/3D-rendered look.
COMPOSITION: a richly illustrated finished cover with depth and carefully placed objects. An unmistakable folded coat of red, gold-yellow, green and blue woven stripes rests over a low wooden bench at the lower LEFT, an open basket of wheat on the RIGHT. A broad softly lit empty stone-and-sand path occupies the LOWER CENTRE, ready for the reading child's own avatar to be composed there by the app. Keep that central foreground EMPTY from roughly x36%–64%, y50%–94%: no person, body, silhouette, placeholder, toy, clothes, basket, or shadow shaped like a figure there.
CAST: only adult supporting people, no depicted Joseph/hero and no children or teenagers. On the middle-distance LEFT, a kind elderly father, olive complexion, grey wavy hair and short grey beard, cream linen tunic, muted indigo outer wrap, wooden walking stick; facing towards the open central path. On the middle-distance RIGHT, three clearly adult brothers in their late twenties to forties, olive-brown complexions: a broad dark-bearded man in terracotta tunic and charcoal shawl; a slender wavy-dark-haired man with a short beard in muted sage tunic and cream scarf; a slightly shorter but clearly mature man with short dark hair and stubble in sand-coloured tunic with muted plum sash. They have warm understated relieved expressions, full natural adult anatomy, no exaggerated cartoon proportions. Keep all adults secondary in scale; this cover is an open invitation for the personalized hero, not a portrait of another protagonist.
BUN: exactly one tiny blue knitted toy rabbit with visible knitted yarn, rounded button-like black eyes, a simple stitched smile, one long ear gently drooping, cream paw pads, sitting beside the LEFT bench away from the hero's place, no larger than an adult ankle/shin. Bun is a plush toy, not a live rabbit or the blue franchise companion Aya.
CALM FINISH: authentic pastoral biblical setting; flowing, readable painterly composition and clear material edges, delicate light and rich depth. All hero identity is supplied later by the app. Absolutely no child, generic hero, baby, toddler, human silhouette, empty human-shaped garment, human reflection, body part emerging from the open hero space, modern object, Bebe, GobGob, or religious icon.

This is a scene background onto which the app later composes the reading child's EXISTING avatar; do not draw the hero or any child.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 (PL1.webp) supplies the established luminous painted picture-book environment style and blue knitted Bun identity. Image 2 (PL4.webp) supplies painterly adult anatomy and fabric/stone/wood material treatment. Image 3 (new Joseph cover) is the CONSISTENCY REFERENCE for the adult supporting cast, their exact clothing/appearance, Bun, granary architecture, and colour/light quality. Create the specified new scene, not a collage and not a copy of the cover layout. Do not copy King Saul, royal crown, armor, swords, shield, marked tree, or sheep.
STYLE: painterly feature-film storybook realism, believable natural anatomy, clear fine brushed forms, tactile linen and woven wool, ancient plaster/mudbrick/timber, softly dimensional light and atmospheric depth. Sophisticated natural colour, gentle expressions, luminous highlights without a yellow wash; warm pastoral biblical world. No modern architecture, technology or franchise styling.
REUSABLE SUPPORTING CAST: the three brothers are unmistakably ADULT men late twenties to forties, olive-brown complexions: broad dark beard/terracotta tunic/charcoal shawl; slender wavy dark hair and short beard/muted sage tunic/cream scarf; a slightly shorter MATURE man with dark hair and stubble/sand tunic/muted plum sash. Keep their appearance consistent with image 3. Other brothers, only if a scene needs them, are clearly adult men in subdued ancient linen. Father appears ONLY when the scene below calls for him: elderly olive-complexioned man with grey wavy hair and short grey beard, cream linen tunic, muted indigo outer wrap, wooden walking stick, exactly as image 3.
BUN if specified below: one small blue knitted TOY rabbit with visible knitted yarn, black button-like eyes, a simple stitched smile, long floppy ears and cream paw pads, like the reference. Keep Bun tiny and secondary, no more than 7% of picture height. Not a human, not a live rabbit, not Aya.
PRODUCTION FRAMING: core narrative action and essential props must remain legible inside the central 50% of the landscape image (x25%–75%), because a portrait 3:4 crop is authored from that window. Place supporting faces, hands and major action mainly in the UPPER half. Supporting people and animals have feet no lower than y62% if within the central window. The LOWER CENTRE is a calm fully-painted EMPTY foreground for the hero: reserve all of x36%–64%, y66%–94% as clear floor/path. No adult, child, limb, body, silhouette, person reflection, animal, Bun, garment, bag, basket, vehicle, chair, tool, table edge or other prop may intrude into this rectangle. Do not draw a placeholder, outline, glow, blank cutout, or human-shaped gap; it must look like natural empty scenery. Keep the right and left framing richly illustrated.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: no depicted Joseph/hero; no child, baby, toddler, teen, or childlike adult; no lettering, numbers, writing, glyphs, labels, hieroglyphs, banners with symbols, speech bubbles, border, panel layout, UI, watermark, crosses, halos, deity figures, wings, magical effect, modern object, Bebe or GobGob. No copy of a source hero. Exactly one complete scene, not a contact sheet.
SCENE — Go Bring Father: outside the same ancient Egyptian granary, warm clear morning. Two patient grey DONKEYS with unmistakable long ears, modest leather-and-woven pack saddles and balanced bulging tied WHEAT SACKS are ready for the journey home. They stand in the upper-central band, one at x30%–43% and one at x59%–73%, feet above y62%, leaving the central foreground path open. No horses or camels on this page. The same three adult brothers stand behind or beside the pack animals, checking one simple tie and preparing to depart; their identical terracotta/charcoal, sage/cream and sand/plum clothes are clean enough, their expressions relieved and hopeful. The barn doors stand open behind with grain supplies visible. A path leads from the courtyard toward distant river fields and hills; sunlight gives the sense of a welcome invitation home. Father has NOT yet arrived; do not depict him, a wagon, the hero, or any child. The essential action is donkeys laden with food for the brothers to bring the family back, never people riding animals. Keep every loaded sack naturally balanced and all anatomy sound. Leave the lower-centre hero rectangle fully empty.
